title: A raw DRILLTHROUGH preceded by an MDX comment is row-capped like any other: capRawDrillthrough skips comments, the ResultSet conversion is bounded, and the statement carries setMaxRows

criteria.given: a raw DRILLTHROUGH body whose keyword is preceded by an MDX comment (/* */, -- or //)
criteria.then: capRawDrillthrough skips the comment, recognises the drillthrough and emits MAXROWS no larger than the server ceiling

criteria.given: RestUtil.convert(ResultSet) called without an explicit limit
criteria.then: it materialises at most QueryGuardrails.maxRows() rows

criteria.given: the raw drillthrough execution path in ThinQueryService
criteria.then: the JDBC statement is bounded with setMaxRows(QueryGuardrails.maxRows()) as well as the MDX MAXROWS

criteria.given: the regression tests for C1 and C2
